question_text: Was Decathlon hacked in the decathlon.fr customer data leak?
answer_text: Yes, by Decathlon's own account. It says someone got malicious access to decathlon.fr customer data at one of its outside providers on Nov 22: names, phone numbers and addresses. It says no bank details or passwords were affected.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Were bank details or passwords taken in the Decathlon leak?
answer_text: Decathlon says not, and an analysis of the posted files found no passwords, card numbers or bank account numbers in them.
label: Reported

what_would_settle_it: Decathlon or the provider naming the company where the access happened.

question_text: How many Decathlon customers are affected?
what_would_settle_it: Decathlon giving the number of customers it is writing to, or a CNIL statement.

question_text: What should decathlon.fr customers do after the leak?
answer_text: Be wary of unexpected texts or emails about a parcel, a delivery or fees to pay, and do not click their links. The leaked files hold names, addresses and recent deliveries, which make fake messages more convincing.
label: Reported

question_text: Is the Decathlon leak linked to the TrainMe leak in October?
answer_text: No link has been shown. France 3 reports the two events have no link at this stage.
label: Reported
